front.note: The four split logs now form a supported crossed stack inside the open rounded fire bowl.

rear.note: The rear silhouette retains the rolled rim and splayed legs with the log layers seated on the grate.

detail.note: Rounded split profiles and restrained bark relief replace the tapered pointed rods; the logs contact at their crossings.

underside.note: The closed convex bowl underside and its three attached legs remain continuous.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms the open vessel, grate and separate contacting wood bodies without relying on color.

front.note: The recessed fire pan occupies a real opening and the surround now connects to the cabinet through a dark apron.

rear.note: The rear stone overhang and continuous apron no longer leave the slab floating over the plinth.

detail.note: The pan has an open interior and rolled rim with a supported crossed log stack.

underside.note: The underside shows the closed cabinet and apron extending to the slab rather than an exposed air gap.

clay.note: The clay view confirms the connected table construction and recessed fire bowl.

front.note: The alternating canopy gores form a smooth continuous umbrella surface supported by the central pole.

rear.note: The far gores retain an even outer hem and continuous crown without detached facets.

detail.note: The closer canopy view shows restrained drape between the radial seams instead of coarse panel steps.

underside.note: The underside retains the radial ribs, runner and braces connected to the pole.

clay.note: The neutral view preserves the umbrella outline while showing a smooth cloth canopy and weighted foot.

front.note: The oven mouth stays open above its cooking deck and the vault now seats along both spring lines.

rear.note: A closed arched end wall replaces the former open rear of the oven barrel.

detail.note: The front opening remains deep and usable; the small refractory sills connect the curved shell to the stone deck.

underside.note: The cart retains attached wheels, cabinet, shelf and support posts under the oven.

clay.note: The neutral view clearly distinguishes the hollow mouth, solid rear enclosure and wheeled supporting cart.

front.note: The shade remains pleated with an open top above the ceramic base and connected brass stem.

rear.note: The rear pleats remain continuous around the hollow shade rather than closing it with a solid cap.

detail.note: The liner sits behind the separate pleats, preserving the scalloped edge and thin open rim.

underside.note: The open bottom exposes the connected central stem, socket and radial spider inside the shade.

clay.note: The clay view confirms a hollow pleated shell above a connected lamp body and base.

front.note: Both recessed food bowls have rounded circular walls and sit in the raised rectangular station.

rear.note: The rear view retains the original corner guards and two separate open bowls.

detail.note: Smooth rolled lips and continuous inner walls replace the former visible low-sided polygon rims.

underside.note: The bowl undersides, supporting platform and four recessed feet remain connected within the original footprint.

clay.note: The neutral view confirms two hollow bowl profiles and the unchanged raised stand construction.
